bull.b: A five-program portfolio diversifies development risk across inherited retinal diseases and creates several opportunities for clinical progress, data readouts and eventual product commercialization rather than relying on a single candidate.

Progression toward pivotal testing and additional clinical starts can strengthen the company’s development platform, generate validation for its technology and create multiple medium-term milestones that may support future partnering or commercialization.

Targeting genetically defined rare diseases can support focused trial recruitment, specialized regulatory pathways and potentially less crowded markets. This positioning may improve development efficiency and strengthen long-term commercial differentiation.

bear.b: Extremely large operating and net losses show that the current business has not reached economic scale. Sustained losses could limit internal investment capacity and require continued financing before pipeline programs can generate meaningful revenue.

The shift from positive equity and no debt during 2023–2025 to negative equity with meaningful borrowings weakens financial flexibility. It may constrain future financing options and increase the consequences of further development delays.

Heavy and recurring cash consumption indicates that operations and clinical development depend on external capital. Continued burn raises funding and dilution risk, especially if trials take longer or require more spending than planned.
